title: Decoding a captured protocol
hints: Keep one buffer. `take` walks it from the front: while at least 2 bytes remain, read the length; if the whole frame is there, decode it and move on, otherwise stop. Remove everything consumed in one `erase` at the end.
Build big-endian numbers by shifting: `(b[0] << 8) | b[1]` for 16 bits. For the signed moves, cast the 16-bit result to `std::int16_t` so `FF FF` becomes -1.
